description: The last 7 days of this application's mail: delivered, bounced and reported as spam, whether it is healthy or one to watch, the recent problems with the reason Resend gave, and the rules the platform uses to stop an application's email by itself (at least three addresses bouncing that are a fifth of a day's mail, or two spam reports in a week). While `reporting` is false the counts are zero because Resend's reports are not connected: that means unknown, not healthy.
name: email_deliverability
title: How the application's mail is landing
